name: British Columbia

workplaceInjury.name: WorkSafeBC

appealLevels.name: Review Division
appealLevels.notes: Internal review of WorkSafeBC decisions. Submit within 90 days of decision.

appealLevels.name: Workers' Compensation Appeal Tribunal (WCAT)
appealLevels.notes: Independent appeal tribunal. Submit within 150 days of Review Division decision or original decision if Review not pursued.

workplaceInjury.notes: WorkSafeBC handles workplace injury claims. Two-tier appeal system: Review Division, then WCAT.

humanRights.name: BC Human Rights Tribunal
humanRights.notes: File complaint within 12 months of last incident of discrimination.

benefitPrograms.administeringBody: Ministry of Social Development and Poverty Reduction
